front.text: 今天和大家在一起，很高興，現在和大家說再見了。

back.text: Today I am very happy to be with everyone, and now I say goodbye to everyone.
back.notes:
Jīntiān hé dàjiā zài yīqǐ, hěn gāoxìng, xiànzài hé dàjiā shuō zàijiàn le.

「再見」(zàijiàn) 是漢語中常用的告別語，意為「goodbye」或「see you later」。在本句中，它作動詞「說」的賓語，構成「說再見」这一常見搭配，表示交談或聚會結束時的礼貌告别。

back.text: xíguàn - habit; to be used to

back.notes:
Bàba jīntiān kāihuì.

此句中的「開」與「會」組成「開會」，表示舉行或參加會議。

Gǒu shì hǎo péngyou.

狗 means “dog”; here it is the subject of the statement.

back.text: I look at the moon in the room.
back.notes:
Wǒ zài fángjiān kàn yuè.

月 means “moon” here; it is the object of 看, not the month sense.

Wǒ kànjiàn gǒu.

看見 means “see” or “catch sight of”; here it is the main verb taking 狗 as its object.

Jīntiān jǐ hào?

號 in 幾號 means the day or number of a date; it asks which day of the month today is.

Wǒ hē shuǐ.

喝 means “to drink”; here it is a transitive verb taking 水 as its object.

front.text: 先生，你認識這個學校嗎？

back.text: Sir, do you know this school?
back.notes:
xiān sheng, nǐ rèn shi zhè gè xué xiào ma？

先生 is a noun meaning 'Mr.; Sir', used here as a term of address for a man, showing respect.

Qǐng nǐ zuò zài zhèlǐ.

坐 means “to sit”; here it is the main verb of the request.

back.text: bǎ - measure word for objects with handles; particle
Please wait for me a few minutes.
back.notes:
Qǐng děng wǒ jǐ fēnzhōng.

分鐘 is a measure word used to count units of time (minutes). In this sentence, it is modified by the quantifier 幾 (several / a few) to indicate a brief duration of time, functioning as the object of the verb 等 (wait).

zhè shì wǒ de shū

的 indicates possession, linking '我' (I) to '書' (book), meaning 'my'.

Tā de érzi zài xuéxiào xuéxí.

「兒子」是名詞，指某人的男性子女；在句中作「在學校學習」的主語。

tiānqì hěn hǎo

好 is an adjective meaning 'good', describing the weather.

Wǒ xiě míngzi.

寫 means “to write”; here it is the main verb with 名字 as what is written.

back.text: bùdàn... érqiě... - not only... but also...

back.notes:
zhè gè rén shéi?

誰 is an interrogative pronoun meaning 'who'. It is used here to ask about the identity of the person referred to by '這個人' (this person).

back.text: yuè... yuè... - the more... the more...

front.text: 那件衣服很漂亮，我很喜歡。

back.text: That piece of clothing is very pretty, and I like it very much.
back.notes:
Nà jiàn yīfú hěn piàoliang, wǒ hěn xǐhuan.

漂亮 is an adjective meaning 'pretty' or 'beautiful'. In this sentence, it serves as the predicate adjective describing '衣服' (clothing), and is modified by the adverb '很' (very) to indicate degree. It is used in the first clause of a compound sentence to describe the clothing, leading to the speaker's positive reaction in the second clause.

Zhège rén jiào shénme míngzi?

叫 means “to be called” and functions as the verb linking the subject to its name.

Nǎ ge yīshēng shì nǐ de péngyou?

此句中的「哪」是疑問代詞，修飾「個醫生」，詢問哪一位醫生。

front.text: 今天天氣太熱了，學生們都在教室裡。

back.text: The weather today is too hot, and the students are all in the classroom.
back.notes:
Jīntiān tiānqì tài rè le, xuéshēng men dōu zài jiàoshì lǐ.

In this sentence, '太' is an adverb meaning 'too' or 'excessively'. It modifies the adjective '熱' (hot) to indicate an excessive degree, forming the structure '太...了' to express a subjective evaluation of the weather.

Wǒ sān suì.

歲 is the age word; after 三 it states an age of three years.

Wǒ dǎ diànhuà gěi māma.

打電話 means “make a phone call”; here it is the main verb, and 給 marks the person called.

Wǒ rènshi nà ge yīshēng.

此句中的「認識」是動詞，表示知道或熟悉某人。

back.text: zhī - measure word for certain animals/birds

back.notes:
Qǐng xiě nǐ de míngzi.

此句中的「名字」是名詞，表示人的名稱。

Wǒ zhù zài xuéxiào hòumiàn.

此句中的「住」是動詞，表示居住。
